overall_goal: Cool the mixture and mix it well

goals.description: Mix the hot dates and biscuits with a spatula and check the temperature
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to mix and break up the hot dates and biscuits, then touches the mixture to check if it has cooled down.

goals.description: Attempt to mix the mixture by hand and switch back to the spatula
goals.rationale: The person cleans off the spatula to try mixing by hand, but finds the mixture is still too hot and resumes breaking it apart with the spatula.
